description: This file defines classes for parsing and representing a CMake cache file, including handling different cache entry types and providing methods to access and manipulate cache data.

classes.name: CMakeCacheEntry
classes.description: Represents a single entry in a CMake cache, capable of parsing and converting cache types to Python types.

classes.name: CMakeCache
classes.description: Handles parsing, storing, and accessing entries from a CMake cache file.

methods.name: from_line
methods.description: Parses a line from a CMake cache file into a CMakeCacheEntry object.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and parses the cache file, storing entries internally.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cache entry by name, with optional default.

methods.name: get_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of values for a cache entry, converting from string if necessary.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Allows dictionary-like access to cache entry values.

methods.name: __setitem__
methods.description: Sets a cache entry, expecting a CMakeCacheEntry object.

methods.name: __delitem__
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by name.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all cache entries.
